receipt.presetGone: {{preset}} is gone, so nothing was loaded
receipt.presetFailed: {{preset}} didn't load fully: some of its settings may not have changed
receipt.loadAsked: Yames asked about your unsaved changes first. Nothing is loaded until you answer.

propose.playExerciseNotAt: Play {{title}} ({{path}} · Step {{step}}). It starts at {{bpm}} BPM, not {{asked}}: Faster takes it up a rung at a time.
propose.findEdge: Find your edge on {{title}} ({{path}} · Step {{step}}), from {{bpm}} BPM
propose.testOut: Test out of Step {{step}}: {{title}}, in {{takes}} Takes
propose.loopBar: Loop bar {{bar}} at {{bpm}} BPM, until you stop it
propose.loopBars: Loop bars {{from}} to {{to}} at {{bpm}} BPM, until you stop it

notFound.drawing: The app can't draw that one.
notFound.swap: Nothing called “{{query}}” can go in part {{part}}.
notFound.rung: There's no tempo to set there.
notFound.settingValue: {{key}} can't be “{{query}}”. These are what it can be:
notFound.loopAcross: Bars {{from}} to {{to}} run off the end of the tune and into its start again. Ask for bars inside one round of it.

notNow.session: Not during a Session. Exit it first.
notNow.rungFar: {{asked}} BPM is more than one tempo away from {{bpm}}: one step at a time.
notNow.notGradable: The app can't measure an edge on {{title}}.
notNow.nothingToTest: There's nothing on Step {{step}} to test out of.

noSwap.harder: There's nothing harder to put in part {{part}}.
noSwap.harderWarmUp: There's no harder warm-up for part {{part}}.
noSwap.different: There's nothing else to put in part {{part}}.
noSwap.style: There's nothing in another style for part {{part}}.

notNow.loopHere: A loop starts from an Exercise in a Session, between Takes.

why.notWiredYet: The app can't do that from here yet.

refused.shape: That isn't something the app can do.
refused.proposal: That has changed since, so nothing was done. Ask again.
refused.cap: You follow {{cap}} Paths, the most there can be. Leave one on its page first.
refused.loopBackwards: Bar {{to}} comes before bar {{from}}. Name the first bar first.

why.failed: That didn't work, and nothing was changed.

yours.input: That one is yours. The coach never switches the input on or off. Listen on the tools and the session bar do it, and Settings has the input.
yours.devices: That one is yours. The coach never chooses or changes your audio devices. They're in Settings.
yours.grading: That one is yours. The coach never changes whether you're graded. It's in Settings, and the session bar asks when you start.
yours.recording: That one is yours. The coach never starts or stops a recording. Recording is in Settings.
yours.deleting: That one is yours. The coach never deletes anything: not a Take, a run, a preset or a song. What is kept is in Settings.
yours.unfollowing: That one is yours. The coach never stops you following a Path. Leave it on its page in Paths.
yours.model: That one is yours. The coach never downloads a model or picks one. The choice is at the foot of this panel and in Settings.
yours.grades: That one is yours. The coach never changes a grade, a clean tempo or whether a Take was fair: they are measured. Your Takes are in Progress.

ui.undoGone: The way back is no longer there: things have moved on since.
ui.chipsIntro: Without a question, the app can do one of these:

value.auto: not set: the app chooses (off under a graded Take on a microphone)
